audience: developers and operations teams that run apps, services and deployments on Koyeb

useCases.title: Find failing services and their errors
useCases.text: List the services of an app with their status and recent activity. Query the stored logs of a failing service to find the errors.

useCases.title: Check CPU, memory and traffic of a service
useCases.text: Read a metric time series for a service or an instance, such as CPU, memory or response time. Compare it with the scaling settings of the service.

useCases.title: Redeploy a service from a commit
useCases.text: Start a new deployment of a service, optionally from a git commit. Read the deployment status, or cancel it while it still builds or rolls out.

useCases.title: Pause and resume an app or a service
useCases.text: Pause an app or a service to stop its public URLs from serving traffic. Resume it later to start its instances again.

useCases.title: Review domains and persistent volumes
useCases.text: List the custom and Koyeb domains with their verification status. List the persistent volumes and the services they attach to.
